summary: Backend regression tested. 10/17 pass. CRITICAL: /api/jobs/fetch crashes (offset-naive/aware datetime compare in services/jobs.py); /api/applications POST crashes (Mongo $set + $setOnInsert conflict on app_id). These cascade to job list empty, match, cover-letter, applications PATCH/list. Auth, resume upload+parse (Claude), preferences, stats, graduate filter all pass. Frontend not yet exercised due to backend job pipeline being broken.

critical.issue: 500 TypeError: can't compare offset-naive and offset-aware datetimes. In services/jobs.py fetch_all_jobs() filter `j['posted_at'] >= cutoff_12`. _themuse() / _remotive() fallback `posted = _now()` is tz-aware, but `datetime.fromisoformat(j['publication_date'].replace('Z','+00:00'))` may still return naive when The Muse returns dates without Z/offset. Result: zero jobs ever saved, breaking entire job/match/cover-letter/application flow.

500 pymongo.errors.WriteError: Updating the path 'app_id' would create a conflict at 'app_id'. server.py upsert uses both $set (which includes app_id via doc) AND $setOnInsert {app_id: aid}. MongoDB forbids both touching same field. Fix: drop app_id from $set dict (only set on insert).
Cascading failures because /jobs/fetch never succeeds -> jobs collection empty -> match/cover-letter return 404.

minor.issue: Bare `except Exception as e:` with unused `e` variable; swallows all LLM errors silently. Consider logging.
secure=True + samesite='none' is correct for cross-origin, but cookie also lacks domain attribute — verify it survives the preview proxy.

integration_issues.issue: All downstream UI features will appear empty/broken until backend jobs/fetch + applications POST bugs are fixed.

action_items: Fix services/jobs.py: normalise every job['posted_at'] to tz-aware UTC before filtering (e.g. `if posted.tzinfo is None: posted = posted.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)`).

Fix server.py POST /api/applications upsert: build the $set dict without app_id, keep $setOnInsert {app_id: aid, created_at: now}. e.g. set_fields = {k:v for k,v in doc.items() if k not in ('created_at','app_id')}.
After both fixes, rerun /app/backend/tests/test_applymate_au.py — should pass all 17. Then frontend e2e can be exercised.

rca of the issue: 1) services/jobs.py:166-170 filters by `j['posted_at'] >= cutoff_12` where cutoff_12 is tz-aware. The Muse / Remotive fromisoformat results can be naive when publication_date lacks Z/offset. The seed jobs use _now()-timedelta which IS tz-aware so filtering them works, but the exception only fires when any external job returns naive. Fix: normalise after parsing. 2) server.py:346-351 builds upsert with $set containing app_id and $setOnInsert also containing app_id → MongoDB rejects conflicting path. Remove app_id from $set.
